functions.inspect_endpoint: socket pathname; expected UID and GID -> EndpointIdentity or AdmissionDenied
functions.assert_endpoint_unchanged: path and pinned identity -> True or AdmissionDenied
functions.verify_legacy_fence: only executes under forbidden nonroot UID; O_RDWR denial -> True; all ambiguous cases deny
functions.verify_storage_owner: regular file, owner UID, nlink=1, mode <=0600 -> True or AdmissionDenied

limits: inspection is not atomic with connect
legacy fencing requires independently provisioned filesystem permissions
not integrated as mandatory path in existing service
